Purpose: Estimate random-effects risk differences versus placebo


```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
rm(list=ls())

library(haven)
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(rlang)
library(writexl)

library(meta)
library(metafor)
```



# Load data

```{r load_data, echo=FALSE}
datapath <- paste0(here(),"/data_sas/")

dat_inc_rd <- read_sas(paste0(datapath, "risk_diff.sas7bdat"))

dat_inc_rd_dose <- read_sas(paste0(datapath, "risk_diff_drug_group1.sas7bdat"))
```


```{r}
dat_lira <- dat_inc_rd %>% filter(drug_group0 == "Liraglutide")
dat_sema <- dat_inc_rd %>% filter(drug_group0 == "Semaglutide")
dat_tirz <- dat_inc_rd %>% filter(drug_group0 == "Tirzepatide")
dat_orli <- dat_inc_rd %>% filter(drug_group0 == "Orlistat")
dat_nabu <- dat_inc_rd %>% filter(drug_group0 == "Naltrexone/Bupropion")
dat_phto <- dat_inc_rd %>% filter(drug_group0 == "Phentermine/Topiramate")
```

## Create a GLP-1 subdata

Include GLP-1Ra drugs (Liraglutide, Semaglutide, Tirzepatide) in the analysis.
```{r}
dat_glp <- dat_inc_rd %>%
  mutate(
    drug_group2 = case_when(
      drug_group0  %in% c("Liraglutide", "Semaglutide", "Tirzepatide") ~ "GLP-1Ra",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  ) %>% 
  filter(drug_group2 == "GLP-1Ra") 
```


## GLP-1 that only includes lira and sema

Include GLP-1Ra drugs (Liraglutide, Semaglutide) in the analysis.
```{r}
dat_glp_v2 <- dat_inc_rd %>%
  mutate(
    drug_group3 = case_when(
      drug_group0  %in% c("Liraglutide", "Semaglutide") ~ "GLP-1Ra",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  ) %>% 
  filter(drug_group3 == "GLP-1Ra") 
```


```{r}
# REVIEW R08: k / nrow count comparisons, not necessarily independent studies.
# Check shared controls in pooled class analyses; model settings are retained.
run_meta_analysis <- function(data, output_plot_dir) {
  outcomes <- unique(data$outcome_l2)
  timepoints <- unique(data$timec2)
  
  all_meta_summaries <- list()
  
  for (outcome in outcomes) {
    for (timepoint in timepoints) {
      subset_data <- data %>% 
        filter(outcome_l2 == outcome, timec2 == timepoint)

      # Skip if no sufficient data (less than 2 studies)
      if(nrow(subset_data) < 2) next

      # Perform meta-analysis
      meta_result <- metabin(
        event.e = events_drug,
        n.e = total_n_drug,
        event.c = events_pbo,
        n.c = total_n_pbo,
        data = subset_data,
        studlab = study,
        sm = "RD",
        method = "Inverse",
        incr = 0.5, # adds 0.5 to all cells with zeros
        method.incr = "only0", #continuity correction method should be used when only0
        # method = "MH",
        random = TRUE
      )

      # Extract results
      meta_summary <- data.frame(
        Outcome = outcome,
        Timepoint = timepoint,
        Number_of_Studies = meta_result$k,
        RD_Estimate = meta_result$TE.random,
        Lower_CI = meta_result$lower.random,
        Upper_CI = meta_result$upper.random,
        Heterogeneity_Q = meta_result$Q,
        Heterogeneity_pval = meta_result$pval.Q,
        I_squared = meta_result$I2,
        Tau_squared = meta_result$tau^2
      ) %>%
        mutate(RD_with_CI = sprintf("%.3f (%.3f, %.3f)", RD_Estimate, Lower_CI, Upper_CI))

      all_meta_summaries[[paste(outcome, timepoint, sep = "_")]] <- meta_summary

      # Create forest plot
      plot_filename <- paste0(output_plot_dir, "/forestplot_",
                              gsub("[^a-zA-Z0-9]", "_", outcome), "_",
                              gsub("[^a-zA-Z0-9]", "_", timepoint), ".png")
      
      png(plot_filename, width = 14, height = 5, units = "in", res = 300)
      forest(meta_result,
             xlab = "Risk Difference (95% CI)",
             leftlabs = c("Study", "Drug Events", "Drug Total", "Placebo Events", "Placebo Total"),
             label.e = "Drug",
             label.c = "Placebo",
             comb.random = TRUE,
             digits = 3,
             smlab = "Risk Difference",
             col.square = "navy",
             col.diamond = "darkred",
             col.diamond.lines = "darkred")
      dev.off()
    }
  }

  # Combine all summaries into one dataframe
  meta_summary_df <- bind_rows(all_meta_summaries)
  return(meta_summary_df)
}
```

# Subgroup analysis - by indication

## Bring in sample characteristics dataset
```{r}
dat_inc_sc <- read_sas(paste0(datapath, "kq1_inc_rct_samchar.sas7bdat"))

# keep one record per extraction_id where flag_ind_diabetes = 1
dat_dm <- dat_inc_sc %>% 
  filter(flag_ind_diabetes == 1) %>%
  group_by(Extraction_ID) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()
# Keep studies with diabetes indication
dat_inc_rd_dose_dm <- inner_join(dat_inc_rd_dose, 
                                dat_dm %>% select(Extraction_ID), 
                                by = "Extraction_ID") 


# Keep one record per extraction_id where flag_ind_weight = 1
dat_wt <- dat_inc_sc %>% 
  filter(flag_ind_weight == 1) %>%
  group_by(Extraction_ID) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()
# Keep studies with diabetes indication
dat_inc_rd_dose_wt <- inner_join(dat_inc_rd_dose, 
                                dat_wt %>% select(Extraction_ID), 
                                by = "Extraction_ID") 

```

## Function to generate one csv per subgroup

```{r}
run_rd_meta_subgrp <- function(input_data, output_csv) {

  # Get unique values
  drugs <- unique(input_data$drug_group1)
  outcomes <- unique(input_data$outcome_l2)
  timepoints <- unique(input_data$timec2)

  # Store all summaries
  all_meta_summaries <- list()

  # Loop through drugs, outcomes, and timepoints
  for (drug in drugs) {
    drug_data <- input_data %>% filter(drug_group1 == drug)

    for (outcome in outcomes) {
      for (timepoint in timepoints) {
        subset_data <- drug_data %>%
          filter(outcome_l2 == outcome, timec2 == timepoint)

        # Skip if not enough data
        if (nrow(subset_data) < 2) next

        # Run meta-analysis
        meta_result <- metabin(
          event.e = events_drug,
          n.e = total_n_drug,
          event.c = events_pbo,
          n.c = total_n_pbo,
          data = subset_data,
          studlab = study,
          sm = "RD",
          method = "Inverse",
          incr = 0.5,
          method.incr = "only0",
          random = TRUE
        )

        # Store summary
        meta_summary <- data.frame(
          Drug = drug,
          Outcome = outcome,
          Timepoint = timepoint,
          Number_of_Studies = meta_result$k,
          RD_Estimate = meta_result$TE.random,
          Lower_CI = meta_result$lower.random,
          Upper_CI = meta_result$upper.random,
          Heterogeneity_Q = meta_result$Q,
          Heterogeneity_pval = meta_result$pval.Q,
          I_squared = meta_result$I2,
          Tau_squared = meta_result$tau^2
        ) %>%
          mutate(RD_with_CI = sprintf("%.3f (%.3f, %.3f)", RD_Estimate, Lower_CI, Upper_CI))

        key <- paste(drug, outcome, timepoint, sep = "_")
        all_meta_summaries[[key]] <- meta_summary
      }
    }
  }

  # Combine and export results
  meta_summary_df <- bind_rows(all_meta_summaries)
  write.csv(meta_summary_df, file = output_csv, row.names = FALSE)
  
  return(meta_summary_df)
}
```

```{r}
run_rd_meta_subgrp(input_data = dat_inc_rd_dose_dm, output_csv = "data/03_percMA_rd_drug_group1_diabetes.csv")
```

```{r}
run_rd_meta_subgrp(input_data = dat_inc_rd_dose_wt, output_csv = "data/03_percMA_rd_drug_group1_weight.csv")
```
